title: Haru Hisakawa's Takara Shimai Manga Ends, Gets English Release on Manga UP!
content: This year's 11th issue of Square Enix 's Young Gangan magazine published the last chapter on Friday of Haru Hisakawa 's Takara Shimai manga. Additionally, Manga UP! Global announced on Sunday it has added the manga its English service under the title Jackpot Sisters . Manga UP!

title: Reborn!, Irregular at Magic High School, Duel Masters Creators Collaborate on Horo-Beat Manga
content: The June issue of Shogakukan 's Monthly Coro Coro Comics magazine launched a new manga on Friday titled Horo Beat . The first chapter has 66 pages. Duel Masters manga creator Shigenobu Matsumoto is credited for the original work, and is in charge of the storyboard composition.
author: ANN

title: 'Oni no Hanayome' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Character Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kureha 's Oni no Hanayome ( The Ogre's Bride ) novel revealed additional cast and the second character promotional video on Saturday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere in July 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Movie Reveals Character Visuals
content: Witch on the Holy Night anime movie revealed the character visuals for Aoko Aozaki, Alice Kuonji and Soujyuro Sizuki on Saturday. Studio ufotable is animating the movie, which is slated to premiere this year. A key visual was released last March.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Cyborg 009: Nemesis' Reveals Additional Cast
content: The official website of the Cyborg 009: Nemesis anime series revealed additional cast and a new visual (pictured right) on Friday. The anime adapting Shoutarou Ishinomori 's action sci-fi manga will begin streaming in Summer 2026.

title: 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Announces Main Cast
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) for the anime movie adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel announced main cast on Saturday. Produced by ufotable , the film is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in 2026.
